6️⃣ Be Bold and Creative

Memes, guerrilla marketing, or PR stunts - crypto loves the wild ones.

Tesla buying Bitcoin? Headlines for weeks.
Dogecoin to the Moon? A literal rocket.

Takeaway: Play to crypto’s love for the outrageous. Unique ideas = attention.

Web3’s most powerful trait - Resilience. 

When markets crash, it’s the community that keeps projects alive. Think @MakerDAO during Black Thursday or the passion behind meme tokens like @dogecoin and @pepecoineth. Communities are the real MVPs.

Step 3: Learn Token Types (this is crucial)

There are basically 4 types: 
→ Coins: @Bitcoin , @ethereum  (have their own blockchain) 
→ Tokens: $USDT, $LINK (built on other blockchains) 
→ Stablecoins: $USDC, $USDT (pegged to USD) 
→ Memecoins: $DOGE, $SHIB
